title: R2 Verdict and BLOCK-001 Correction
verdict_rationale: AB-0-R1 provides structured execution analysis supported by prior Factory trial validation (P5, P7, RW2, P6-R1). Scoring is substantiated by documented behaviors and gate validations. However, two concerns prevent full CONFIRMED status: (1) Actual code-generation artifacts are not present in harness directories — evidence is governance/report-level, not raw output. (2) Identical scores to AB-0 design raise provenance concern — cannot definitively prove scores were independently derived rather than carried forward.
